links.outcome: Effect of seven-question visual decomposition and balanced adjudication ablations on screening performance
links.effect: Ablations showed that seven-question visual decomposition and balanced final adjudication were critical to the high-sensitivity operating point; the full framework outperformed clinical-only, direct multimodal, and naive two-stage pipelines.
links.quote: Ablations showed that seven-question visual decomposition and balanced final adjudication were critical to the high-sensitivity operating point.

links.outcome: Comparison of EviOSAHS against alternative prompting pipelines on same cohort and protocol
links.effect: EviOSAHS achieved 88.47% accuracy, 94.86% sensitivity, 93.74% F1-score, and 5.14% false-negative rate, outperforming clinical-only prompting, direct multimodal prompting, and naive two-stage pipelines under a unified protocol.
links.quote: EviOSAHS achieved 88.47% accuracy, 94.86% sensitivity, 93.74% F1-score, and a 5.14% false-negative rate, outperforming clinical-only prompting, direct multimodal prompting, and naive two-stage pipelines under a unified protocol.

unlisted_practices: Decomposing multimodal image analysis into fixed anatomical queries producing structured evidence cards before LLM adjudication

screen.reason: Evaluates an evidence-grounded modular reasoning framework (EviOSAHS) designed as a guardrail against unstable, ungrounded direct multimodal foundation model screening decisions for OSAHS.

primary.practice: structured visual evidence decomposition and grounding
